name: FlowFieldAgent
src_typeComment: Drop on any number of agents pointed at the SAME FlowFieldGrid — each just samples its current cell's flow direction every frame and moves that way. Moves the transform directly (kinematic), matching the rest of the toolkit's steering/movement style rather than requiring a Rigidbody.

src_serialized.name: grid
src_serialized.tooltip: The shared FlowFieldGrid this agent reads its movement direction from.

src_serialized.name: faceMovementDirection
src_serialized.tooltip: Rotates the agent to face its movement direction.
